sentences: The authors used the line's absence from the images to estimate that its "equivalent width," a measure of the line's features, was at least 7,620 Å
The blank space had become a clue that could help narrow down the source
Then the investigation took an unexpected turn

items.source_sentence: The authors used the line's absence from the images to estimate that its "equivalent width," a measure of the line's features, was at least 7,620 Å
items.source_sentence_ja: 著者たちは、画像にその線が写っていないことを利用して、その線の特徴を示す指標である「等価幅」が少なくとも7,620 Åあると推定した。

items.source_sentence: The blank space had become a clue that could help narrow down the source
items.source_sentence_ja: 空白部分は、発生源を絞り込む手がかりになり得るものになっていた。

items.source_sentence: Then the investigation took an unexpected turn
items.source_sentence_ja: その後、調査は予想外の展開を見せた。

items.source_sentence: In the area they observed, they closed small windows that overlapped with some celestial objects already known, while leaving almost all the others open
items.source_sentence_ja: 彼らは観測した領域で、すでに知られている天体の一部と重なる小さな窓を閉じ、ほかのほぼすべての窓は開けたままにした。

items.source_sentence: A mystery like this, enough to frustrate any detective, has appeared in space
items.source_sentence_ja: どんな探偵も手を焼くような謎が、宇宙に現れた。
